label.zh-TW: App Store：Fair 妳不可風格誌 App

title.zh-TW: 首次購買滿 NT$2,000，現折 NT$300
title.en: NT$300 off a first purchase of NT$2,000 or more

text.zh-TW: 結帳時輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RO，訂單現折 NT$300；限首次購買。取自平台分享文案與邀請頁；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Enter promo code MGMCKQ0RO at checkout for NT$300 off; first purchase only. From the share text and invite page; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（會前往 Fair 的邀請頁）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (it leads to the Fair invitation page).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示登入或註冊會員。
steps.en: Log in or register as a member as the page asks.

steps.zh-TW: 選購商品，讓首次購買的訂單金額達 NT$2,000 以上。
steps.en: Shop so that your first purchase order reaches NT$2,000 or more.

steps.zh-TW: 結帳時輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RO（已包含在連結中；若結帳頁沒有自動帶入，請手動輸入），訂單即現折 NT$300。
steps.en: At checkout, enter promo code MGMCKQ0RO (already in the link; if it is not filled in, type it in) for NT$300 off the order.

intro.zh-TW: Fair 妳不可風格誌首次購買訂單滿 NT$2,000，結帳輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RO，訂單現折 NT$300。
intro.en: Fair Lady’s online shop: first purchase of NT$2,000 or more, enter promo code MGMCKQ0RO at checkout for NT$300 off.

description.zh-TW:
Fair 妳不可風格誌是台灣的女性時尚品牌，提供線上購物。本頁連結已包含優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RO；依邀請頁，好友限首次購買，訂單消費達 NT$2,000（含）以上，訂單現折 NT$300。

活動期間為 2026-02-01 至 2026-12-31；首張訂單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單就沒有這項優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
Fair (also written Fair Lady) is a women’s fashion brand in Taiwan with its own online shop. The promo code MGMCKQ0RO is already part of the referral link on this page. According to the invitation page, an invited friend can use it only on a first purchase, and an order of NT$2,000 or more gets NT$300 off. If the code is needed at checkout, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.

The invitation page shows a campaign period of 2026-02-01 to 2026-12-31, and if the first order is cancelled or returned, later orders no longer get the offer. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RO 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣（含大小寫），第 7 碼是數字 0，結尾是英文字母 O。優惠碼是否被接受，本站沒有實際結帳測試。
notes.en: Promo code MGMCKQ0RO is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization: the 7th character is the digit 0 and the last is the letter O. This site did not test whether the code is accepted at checkout.

q.zh-TW: MGMCKQ0RO 這組優惠碼怎麼使用？
q.en: How do I use promo code MGMCKQ0RO?

a.zh-TW: 依邀請頁，限首次購買，訂單消費達 NT$2,000（含）以上，結帳時使用優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RO，訂單現折 NT$300。本頁連結已包含這組優惠碼；若需要輸入，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。
a.en: According to the invitation page, on a first purchase only, an order of NT$2,000 or more gets NT$300 off with promo code MGMCKQ0RO at checkout. The code is already part of the link on this page; if you need to type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.

q.zh-TW: 這個折扣是給誰的？有活動期限嗎？
q.en: Who gets the discount, and is there a deadline?

a.zh-TW: 折扣給被邀請的好友，限第一筆訂單；首單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單沒有這項優惠。邀請頁顯示的活動期間是 2026-02-01 至 2026-12-31，實際條件以官方公告為準。
a.en: The discount is for the invited friend and only on the first order; if that first order is cancelled or returned, later orders get no offer. The invitation page shows a campaign period of 2026-02-01 to 2026-12-31, and actual terms follow the official announcements.
